typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		APPL_ID_CT as integer,
		USER_CT as integer,
		CNTCT_AU_NAME as string,
		RPT_DT as timestamp,
		DB_OBJ_CT as integer,
		CNTCT_AU_NUM as integer,
		CURRENT_PERM_SPACE_GB as double,
		CNTCT_EMAIL_ADDR as string,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_CREATE_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_ALTER_DT as timestamp,
		TBL_CT as integer,
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		CREATE_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_QRY_DT as timestamp,
		MAX_PERM_SPACE_GB as double,
		PLTFM_TXT as string,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		REC_CT as long,
		CONTACT_EMP_ID as long,
		ENCRYPT_CD as string,
		NON_US_BASED_USER_CT as integer,
		QRY_CT as long,
		CNTCT_FULL_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  DATABASENAME ,RPT_DT ,PLTFM_TXT ,ENVRN_TXT ,CREATE_DT ,ENCRYPT_CD ,USER_CT ,APPL_ID_CT ,NON_US_BASED_USER_CT ,DB_OBJ_CT ,TBL_CT ,VIEW_CT ,MACRO_CT ,SP_CT ,PROXY_RIGHT_CT ,QRY_CT ,QRY_WNDW_DY_CT ,LAST_QRY_DT ,MAX_PERM_SPACE_GB ,CURRENT_PERM_SPACE_GB ,FREE_PERM_SPACE_GB ,PERM_SPACE_UTLZ_PCT ,REC_CT ,REC_CT_COLL_DT ,TBL_GT_90DY_CT ,LAST_TBL_DDL_CREATE_DT ,LAST_TBL_DDL_ALTER_DT ,CONTACT_EMP_ID ,CNTCT_FULL_NAME ,CNTCT_EMAIL_ADDR ,CNTCT_AU_NUM ,CNTCT_AU_NAME from TDINFINFO.V_PR00045_ENTPS_SNDBX_INFO_HIST qualify RPT_DT >= add_months(max(RPT_DT) over (), -3)',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ADONETSource
ADONETSource sink(input(
		APPL_ID_CT as string,
		USER_CT as string,
		CNTCT_AU_NAME as string,
		RPT_DT as string,
		DB_OBJ_CT as string,
		CNTCT_AU_NUM as string,
		CURRENT_PERM_SPACE_GB as string,
		CNTCT_EMAIL_ADDR as string,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_CREATE_DT as string,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_ALTER_DT as string,
		TBL_CT as string,
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		CREATE_DT as string,
		LAST_QRY_DT as string,
		MAX_PERM_SPACE_GB as string,
		PLTFM_TXT as string,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		REC_CT as string,
		CONTACT_EMP_ID as string,
		ENCRYPT_CD as string,
		NON_US_BASED_USER_CT as string,
		QRY_CT as string,
		CNTCT_FULL_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		APPL_ID_CT,
		USER_CT,
		CNTCT_AU_NAME,
		RPT_DT,
		DB_OBJ_CT,
		CNTCT_AU_NUM,
		CURRENT_PERM_SPACE_GB,
		CNTCT_EMAIL_ADDR,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_CREATE_DT,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_ALTER_DT,
		TBL_CT,
		ENVRN_TXT,
		CREATE_DT,
		LAST_QRY_DT,
		MAX_PERM_SPACE_GB,
		PLTFM_TXT,
		DATABASENAME,
		REC_CT,
		CONTACT_EMP_ID,
		ENCRYPT_CD,
		NON_US_BASED_USER_CT,
		QRY_CT,
		CNTCT_FULL_NAME),
	partitionFileNames:['$OLEDBDestination_outputfilename'],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
